title: RMOS-CONVERGE-001B-B2: converge the adaptive sibling; hold drilling, profiling and V-carve with evidence
intent: Second bounded step of sibling machine-output convergence, base main@b5e08279 after PR #314 merged. Four candidates were traced individually and resolve into four different defect classes, only one of which was a convergence target. Adaptive is converged. Drilling, profiling and V-carve are converted from vague 'sibling bypass' labels into evidence-backed HOLD states, each requiring a separate decision. The retract capability required no work: its client hardening and query-parameter binding already landed on main before this tranche, so it appears here only as regression control.
behavior_change: No production route is taken offline by this change, and no route that previously succeeded now fails. Adaptive: POST /api/cam/pocket/adaptive/gcode already gated correctly (it calls plan(), which enforces safety policy), so valid requests still succeed and blocked requests still return 409. What changes is the persisted record - the run now carries the decision and feasibility hash produced by the gate instead of a hardcoded GREEN and a hash of the request. tool_id moves from 'adaptive_gcode' to 'adaptive:gcode' so the run carries the identity resolve_mode recognises. Client: two adaptive composables now check HTTP success before reading the response, so a governed 409 can no longer be written to disk as a .nc file or displayed as NC text; successful exports are unaffected. Drilling, profiling and V-carve server and client code are untouched.

diff_articulation.what_changed: (1) services/api/app/routers/adaptive/gcode_router.py: the route obtains its decision explicitly from plan_router._enforce_safety_policy - the same helper plan() uses - before generation, and persists that decision, that feasibility payload and that feasibility hash. It previously recorded RunDecision(risk_level='GREEN') unconditionally with feasibility_sha256 set to a hash of the request, described in-code as a proxy 'because plan validated'. A YELLOW plan was therefore filed as GREEN against a hash that was not a feasibility hash. tool_id corrected to 'adaptive:gcode'. (2) packages/client/src/components/toolbox/cam-essentials/useGcodeExport.ts: new ensureArtifactResponseOk(response, operation) throws on non-2xx after extracting the governed reason, still throws when the error body is not JSON, and does not consume a successful body; readGcodeOrThrow now delegates to it and is otherwise unchanged for its existing callers. This is deliberately not a media-neutral rewrite - adaptive's export path reads .blob(), which the text-returning readGcodeOrThrow cannot guard, so the capability being cut over got the guard it needed and nothing wider. (3) useToolpathExport.ts and usePocketPlanning.ts: both previously read the response with no status check, one into an NC preview pane via .text() and one straight into a .nc download via .blob(); both now guard first. (4) useGcodeExport.spec.ts: three new cases for the guard, including that a successful body is left unread. (5) New test module with 7 server witnesses including a source-position ordering assertion (gate < plan < assembly) and an AST guard against literal RunDecision(risk_level=...). (6) Census appended with the 001B-B2 section: the four-class refinement, the adaptive reclassification from BYPASS to authority/provenance mis-recording, drilling as a stage-contract mismatch, the new PROFILING-ROUTE-ANNOTATION-001 finding, V-carve unchanged, residuals, and a grounding-provenance note recording that earlier client conclusions came from a stale checkout and were discarded.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: The adaptive change closes a real audit-integrity defect: the run artifact asserted a safety decision the evaluator had not made, and cited a feasibility hash that hashed the request instead. The client changes close the corresponding consumer half - without them this tranche's own governed 409 would have been saved as a machine file, which is the defect 001B-A left live for retract and which main has since fixed there. The census work is not decoration: it replaces a coarse 'sibling bypass' count with four distinct, evidenced classes, which materially lowers the number of true output-authority bypasses the programme still believes it has.
